RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS  Petition(s) for Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No(s).

390  (Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 08-02-2024  in CRR No. 2859/2018 passed by the High Court At Calcutta)
 R.K. SEKHRI & ANR. Petition  VERSUS  STATE OF WEST BENGAL & ANR. Respondent(s)
 IA No. 167671/2024 - PASSING APPROPRIATE ORDER OR DECREE UNDER ARTICLE 142 OF THE CONSTITUTION  Date : 14-08-2024 This petition was called on for hearing today.

CORAM :
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.M. SUNDRESH  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP MEHTA

For Petitioner(s) Mr. Vikram Chaudhri, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Nikhil Jain, AOR  Ms. Rishi Sehgal, Adv.
 Ms. Arveen Sekhon, Adv.
 Ms. Hargun Sandhu, Adv.
 Ms. Muskaan Khurana, Adv.
 Ms. Divya Jain, Adv.
 For Respondent(s) Ms. Partibha Yadav, Adv.
 Ms. Astha Sharma, AOR  Mr. Rana S Biswas, Adv.
 Mr. Sunil Kumar Sharma, AOR  UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R IA No. 167671/2024 - PASSING APPROPRIATE ORDER OR DECREE UNDER ARTICLE 142 OF THE CONSTITUTION A joint application has been filed by the parties being IA No.167671/2024 to record the Reason: settlement entered into between the parties.
In tune with the joint application filed, the pending First Information Report No.6 dated 21.01.2013,
P.S. Jhalda, Purulia, for the offence under Sections 406, 409 and 420 IPC, culminating into charge R.K. Sekhri vs State Of West Bengal on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74995804/
1 sheet No.27/2015 and FIR No.88 dated 18.06.2015, registered with P.S. Civil Lines, Batala, Punjab for the offence under Sections 406, 419, 420, 464, 466, 471, 506, 34 and 120B, IPC all of which stand quashed along with the pending suit in Money Suit No.23/2017 pending on the file of 3 rd Court of Ld. Civil Judge (Senior Division) at Howrah which stands terminated.
The payment of Rs.5 lakh as agreed upon by the petitioner to be paid to the respondent No.2 in the form of a demand draft is also recored as DD No.900645 dated 22.07.2024, drawn on Punjab National Bank which has been handed over by learned counsel for the petitioner to learned counsel for the respondent No.2.
In such view of the matter, the memorandum of settlement agreement/compromise executed between the petitioner and respondent No.2 dated 23.07.2024 is taken on record.
Accordingly, both the criminal proceedings/FIRs are quashed and the civil suit stands terminated.
Consequently, the Special Leave Petition is disposed of on the aforesaid terms.
Pending application(s), if any, stand disposed of.
(ASHA SUNDRIYAL) (POONAM VAI ASTT. REGISTRAR-cum-PS COURT MASTER  * A copy of DD No.900645 dated 22.07.2024 drawn on PNB attached herewith R.K. Sekhri vs State Of West Bengal on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74995804/
